about: The introitus of the formulary “The Holy Innocents, Martyrs” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Out of the mouths of babes and of sucklings, O God, You have fashioned praise because of Your foes. O Lord, our Lord, how glorious is Your name over all the earth! Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
